guide.skyabyss.abyss_v3.terr: Defeat the territory boss guarding the %1$s (marks %2$s/3)
guide.skyabyss.abyss_v3.gate: Three marks. Go to the barred gate north of the camp
guide.skyabyss.abyss_v3.arena: Go down to the lord's hall. %1$s waits
guide.skyabyss.abyss_v3.descend: Take the descending chain at the back of the hall to %1$s
guide.skyabyss.abyss_v3.descend_heart: Take the descending chain at the back of the hall to %1$s
guide.skyabyss.abyss_v3.heart_room: Go through the corridor into the heart chamber
guide.skyabyss.abyss_v3.warden: Defeat the Heart Warden. Light the lanterns and fight in the light
guide.skyabyss.abyss_v3.home: Climb back by the chains and return to the surface from the white lodestone in the bone camp
message.skyabyss.abyss_v3.tip.home: Tip: the white shrine by the west wall of the camp. Touch its lodestone to return to the surface (the gate under the capital) at any time.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v3.tip.board: Tip: right-click the tablet beside each route mouth to see whether its mark is still there and what guards it.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v3.tip.marks: Tip: each of the three routes ends at a mark altar. With all three, the barred gate north of the camp rises.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v3.tip.shortcut: Tip: taking a mark opens the barred shortcut from that route straight back to camp.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v3.tip.arena: Tip: red marks on the floor show where the lord's attacks land. Step out before the red fades. Blades do not bite while it roars.
Mio the lamp-keeper: "Check the tablets by the route mouths. They tell which marks are left. I set lamps every few steps."
Mio the lamp-keeper: "The bone-flute mark down the south route is ringed by a bone nest. Beat all three waves first."
Mio the lamp-keeper: "The rib lord shrugs off blades outside the light. Light the four lamp-stands and fight inside the glow. When it comes to snuff one, stand in the red ring."
Mio the lamp-keeper: "You did it. The chain down is at the back of the hall. Next is the salt layer. Mind the weight of the white shells."
Hayase the surveyor: "This layer is heavy. Breathe, and take the routes one at a time. The salt floor slips; stay off the edges."
Hayase the surveyor: "A territorial white shell-keeper hoards the white-shell mark on the west route. Bring it down to reach the altar."
Hayase the surveyor: "The white-shell lord drops weight under your feet. When the red ring appears, step out at once, and keep an escape path open."
Hayase the surveyor: "Take the chain down to the storm layer. It is loud with heartbeats there. Pick the real one by ear."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v3.survivor.storm: Shizu the apothecary: "The storm routes split three ways. You can read the door locks if you bring a light close. Ask if you need salves."
Shizu the apothecary: "The moth mark on the west route sits in the middle of a storm nest. The third wave brings a lightning idol; break it first."
Shizu the apothecary: "The heartbeat mimic splits in three. The one with the heartbeat is real. Hitting a copy bursts it into a red ring, so back away."
Shizu the apothecary: "Next is the ash layer, with a lord that eats light. Keep your light art ready."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v3.survivor.ash.m: Captain Toya: "The ash layer is a maze. Follow the scorched trail marks. The embers in the walls point the way, too."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v3.survivor.ash.g: Captain Toya: "A great ember-keeper holds the ember mark on the west route. If you catch fire, get out of the ash at once."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v3.survivor.ash.l: Captain Toya: "The light-eater snuffs every lamp with a wave of dark. Blades fail in that dark. Light it up with your light art; that is how you win."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v3.survivor.ash.a: Captain Toya: "Below is the heart. We will wait here. If you lose your way, remember the white lodestone above."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v3.board.head: %1$s "%2$s" - marks on this layer %3$s/3
message.skyabyss.abyss_v3.board.done: %1$s: taken. The shortcut bars are open
message.skyabyss.abyss_v3.board.open: %1$s: still on its altar, at the end of this route
message.skyabyss.abyss_v3.return.title: Back on the surface
message.skyabyss.abyss_v3.return.sub: Before the gate under the capital. The chill of the abyss slowly leaves you
message.skyabyss.abyss_v3.lord.bone.phas: Its ribs split open. Bone rain is coming
Soul fire bursts from the bones. Nowhere on the floor is safe
message.skyabyss.abyss_v3.lord.salt.phas: Its shell rings; a tide ring spreads. Get close to it
The white shell starts to roll. Leave the charge line
message.skyabyss.abyss_v3.lord.storm.pha: Lightning starts running in a cross
The heartbeat quickens; lightning gathers underfoot
message.skyabyss.abyss_v3.lord.ash.phase: The light-eater lunges. Get off the line
message.skyabyss.abyss_v3.lord.fell_sub: At the back of the hall, the descending chain glows
objective.skyabyss.abyss_v3.lord_roar: The lord roars. Blades will not bite. Back off and get ready
